hints: A subset is a yes-or-no choice per value. What else is a sequence of yes-or-no choices?
The bits of a number. There are 2^n numbers of n bits, and each one names a different subset.
So the outer loop counts from 0 to 2^n - 1, and the inner loop reads the bits of the counter.
Bit `i` of `m` is set when `m >> i & 1` is 1, or equivalently when `m & (1 << i)` is not zero.
